title: agrostis alba subsp. coarctata
intro: Agrostis alba subsp. coarctata, commonly known as Alpine Bent, is a subspecies of grass native to mountainous regions. It is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Bent include soothing and calming effects, which can aid in reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
